title: The marketing home scrolls clunkily on a phone: per-frame scale on the fold photos and hero, a 400vh pin, and a stepping grain film

source.ref: Owner report 2026-10-19 in the project chat ('The homepage scroll experience is a little clunky'), thread 'Mobile and design polish'.

detail: FILED 2026-10-19. THE CONSEQUENCE: on a phone, the home page's pinned fold (§02) wrote a new scale() to six drifting photos and to the hero's text and backdrop on every scroll frame. Each photo carried a large blurred box-shadow, so Chrome re-rasterized seven shadowed layers at a fresh scale per frame while the fixed full-screen grain film restarted its steps(6) animation every 1.2s on top. The 400vh pin also held the thumb on one section for four screens. Together they read as a stutter and a jam. THE FIX, phones only (max-width:760px), desktop unchanged: the fold's photos and the hero keep translate and opacity but drop the per-frame scale; the photos lose their blurred shadow; the grain film keeps its texture but stops stepping; the pin shortens from 400vh to 320vh (reversible in site-pages-a.css if the story reads too fast).
